records.rationale: Extract the independent lock-ownership fix: only AOP_WRITEPAGE_ACTIVATE requires the caller to unlock after shmem_writeout. Local shmem/swap writer code unlocks on other returns including hard architecture errors; host contract tests expose the native double unlock. Keep native per-page backup, put_page, NULL/handle guards and restore-state cleanup. Omit compound backup/performance changes and private fault-injection API for the current SDK virtio GEM-shmem implementation. The new compound path changes reserve use, fragmentation and partial-OOM retry behavior, not the configured public allocation API; no TTM module latency/fragmentation parity or impossibility of an optional consumer is asserted.
